task_completion.description: The agent successfully loaded the patient 5 data into 3D Slicer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 3D Slicer interface shows a CT volume and the 'Liver_Complete' segmentation loaded in the Data module or Segment Editor.

task_completion.description: Two new segments named 'Liver_Right' and 'Liver_Left' are created in the segment list.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Segment Editor list shows 'Liver_Right' and 'Liver_Left' as distinct entries.

task_completion.description: The agent uses the Scissors tool to split the original segmentation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Scissors tool is highlighted/active in the Segment Editor effects panel, and a selection lasso or cut line is visible in the slice views or 3D view.

task_completion.description: The original liver is split into two distinct spatial regions.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 2D slice views or 3D view show two different colors representing the left and right lobes, covering the area previously occupied by 'Liver_Complete'.

task_completion.description: Each segment represents 25-75% of the original volume.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Segment Statistics' module or the segment list shows volume values (mm3 or cm3) where both 'Liver_Right' and 'Liver_Left' are roughly similar in size, neither being negligible nor nearly the full size of the original.

integrity.description: The agent used the 3D Slicer GUI rather than Python console scripts to perform the split.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Segment Editor buttons and the Scissors tool, rather than code being typed into the Python Interactor.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply rename the original segment or create empty segments.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 3D view shows two distinct, non-overlapping colored volumes that together form the shape of a liver.

integrity.description: The agent is working on the specified patient 5 data.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file paths in the 'Data' module or the window title bar reference 'patient_5' or 'IRCADb'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task uses patient 5 from the 3D-IRCADb-01 dataset. The original volume is 'Liver_Complete'. The agent must use the 'Scissors' tool in the Segment Editor. Success is defined by the presence of 'Liver_Right' and 'Liver_Left' segments that visually split the liver into two large, roughly equal parts (between 25% and 75% each).
